news.title: UPSC Completes 100 Years with Centenary Celebrations / UPSC ने 100 वर्ष पूरे किए
news.summary: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) completed 100 years since its establishment in 1926. The centenary celebrations were held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. The Prime Minister participated in the programme and a commemorative coin, stamp and book were released. / Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) ने 1926 में स्थापना के बाद 100 वर्ष पूरे किए। Centenary celebrations Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi में आयोजित हुए। प्रधानमंत्री ने कार्यक्रम में भाग लिया तथा commemorative coin, stamp और book जारी की गई।

news.title: Government Revises Sugar Stock Holding Norms / सरकार ने Sugar Stock Holding Norms में बदलाव किया
news.summary: With the new sugar season beginning on 1 October 2026, the Government revised stock holding norms for sugar dealers. The stock holding period was reduced to 15 days and the general stock limit was fixed at 1,000 quintals from 15 October to 30 November 2026, with higher limits for Kolkata metropolitan areas and Assam. / 1 October 2026 से नई sugar season शुरू होने के साथ सरकार ने sugar dealers के stock holding norms में बदलाव किया। Stock holding period 15 days किया गया और 15 October से 30 November 2026 तक सामान्य stock limit 1,000 quintals रखी गई, जबकि Kolkata metropolitan areas और Assam के लिए higher limit रखी गई।

Special Limit / विशेष सीमा : 2,000 Quintals for Kolkata extended metropolitan areas and Assam
Effective Period / प्रभावी अवधि : 15 October–30 November 2026

news.title: Government Strengthens Implementation of PCR and SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Acts / सरकार ने PCR और SC/ST Acts के Implementation को मजबूत किया
news.summary: The Central Government released ₹1,423.30 crore to States and Union Territories over three financial years for implementation of the Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 and the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989. Measures include special courts, victim support, relief, rehabilitation and awareness. / केंद्र सरकार ने Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 और Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 के implementation के लिए तीन financial years में States और UTs को ₹1,423.30 crore जारी किए। इसमें special courts, victim support, relief, rehabilitation और awareness measures शामिल हैं।

news.title: Special Gram Sabhas and People’s Plan Campaign 2026-27 / Special Gram Sabhas और People’s Plan Campaign 2026-27
news.summary: Special Gram Sabhas will be held across India on 2 October 2026 to discuss governance reforms and local development priorities. The People’s Plan Campaign 2026-27, ‘Sabki Yojana, Sabka Vikas’, will support preparation of Gram Panchayat Development Plans for FY 2027-28 through participatory planning. / 2 October 2026 को पूरे भारत में Special Gram Sabhas आयोजित की जाएंगी। इनमें governance reforms और local development priorities पर चर्चा होगी। People’s Plan Campaign 2026-27 ‘Sabki Yojana, Sabka Vikas’ के तहत participatory planning से FY 2027-28 के Gram Panchayat Development Plans तैयार किए जाएंगे।

news.title: RDI Scheme Call Temporarily Closed for Administrative Reasons / RDI Scheme का Call Administrative Reasons से अस्थायी रूप से बंद
news.summary: The Technology Development Board clarified that the running call under the Research Development & Innovation (RDI) Scheme was closed purely for administrative reasons, not due to shortage of funds. The call is expected to reopen after assessment of proposals received up to 30 September 2026. / Technology Development Board ने स्पष्ट किया कि Research Development & Innovation (RDI) Scheme का running call funds की कमी के कारण नहीं बल्कि administrative reasons से बंद किया गया है। 30 September 2026 तक प्राप्त proposals के assessment के बाद call फिर से खुलने की बात कही गई है।

news.title: Jal Shakti Ministry Reviews Drinking Water Coverage in Tribal Areas / Jal Shakti Ministry ने Tribal Areas में Drinking Water Coverage की समीक्षा की
